item.title: DevPulse 0.10.0
item.description:
• Settings › Jira › Projects: list the Jira projects (STORE, WA) in which the quick launcher looks up a bare number and jira <number>; it shows a row for each of them. It replaces the single default project, and your earlier choice is kept as the first entry.
  • The quick launcher shows the title and state of tickets and pull requests that are not in your lists: once you stop typing, it asks Jira and GitHub about them (one request each). Tickets or pull requests that do not exist disappear from a bare number's results, and jira <key> or gh <number> say "Not found".
  • The quick launcher also finds the tickets of your pull requests that are not assigned to you.
  • A pull request links to a Jira key of any project in the list, not only the default one.
